tasks.title: No matching rows when joining multiple tables on binary/varbinary key

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 三表完整16字节binary/varbinary数据，等值连接常量有清楚对应，可检测常量传播丢行。

test_spec.setup: 按正文parents、foos、bars结构与两枚16字节十六进制值建立三行数据。
test_spec.steps: 执行三表JOIN加bars.parent_id十六进制条件；对照增加parents.id同值条件及同类型列。
test_spec.oracle: 应返回一行correct output，等长相等二进制值不能因优化克隆变值导致空。
test_spec.target_applicability: 目标支持同款二进制连接；8.2修复未说明8.0回移。

comments.author: Jon Stephens
comments.text:
Documented fix as follows in the MySQL 8.2.0 changelog:

    A join on a BINARY column with a VARBINARY column of the same
    size, having matching values equal in size to that of the BINARY
    column in both columns, did not produce any matching rows.

Closed.
